snippet.title: Puppergeist - Official Announcement Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Doggie Underworld. Here's your look at the Puppergeist announcement trailer for this upcoming heartfelt rhythm and visual novel adventure about kindness, compassion, and the pets we hold dear. Join the witch Claire on a journey to find her missing pup! In Puppergeist, help doggie spirits through rhythm-based mini-games, uncover touching stories of love and loss, and discover why your Pup was sent to the underworld in the first place. Puppergeist will be available on Xbox and PC via Steam.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
